description: Monthly history of a domain's backlink profile: rank (0-1000), backlinks, new and lost backlinks, referring domains, new and lost referring domains and main domains per month, for up to 24 months (from 2019 on; default the last 24 months) per $0.048 call, from a web link index. Use when tracking link growth or a lost-link drop over time. No history is an empty answer, which is still charged. Bad input is a free 400; a data source failure is not charged. Price: $0.048 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

dateFrom.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, on or after 2019-01-01, at most 24 months before dateTo. Default 24 months before dateTo.

dateTo.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, after dateFrom and not after today (UTC). Default today.

target.description: A domain like example.com (subdomains allowed). A site-root URL such as https://www.example.com/ is reduced to the domain; a path or port is refused.

name: backlinks_history
title: Backlink profile history (up to 24 months)
